'''
		Takes a user's assetRoles, and formats the data and adds columns for assetPaths and assetIds, for table display
		Args:
			userId: int
		Returns:
			list of dictionaries
		Updated:
			jz 11/30/23 - refactored, returning list of dictionaries instead of dataset
	'''
	allRoles = [role for role in system.user.getRoles('default') if role != 'Gateway Admin']
	rolesRows = []
	
	 # initializes roles - assets dictionary for a user
	rolesDict = {row['roleName']: {'roleId': row['roleId'], 'roleName': row['roleName'], 'assetPaths': [], 'assetIds': []} for row in system.kanoa.security.getRoleFunctions({})}
	
	# iterates through user's assetRoles, and populates assetPath list and assetId list for each role
	for row in system.kanoa.security.getUserAssetRoles({'userId': value or -1}):
		if row['assetId'] and row['assetId'] not in rolesDict[row['roleName']]['assetIds']:
			rolesDict[row['roleName']]['assetPaths'].append(row['assetPath'])
			rolesDict[row['roleName']]['assetIds'].append(str(row['assetId']))
	
	# takes the lists of assetPaths and assetIds, and converts them to a comma-separated string
	for role in rolesDict:
		rolesDict[role]['assetPaths'] = ", ".join(list(set(rolesDict[role]['assetPaths'])))
		rolesDict[role]['assetIds'] = ", ".join(list(set(rolesDict[role]['assetIds'])))
		rolesRows.append(rolesDict[role])
	
	rolesRows.sort(key=lambda x: x['roleId'])
	return rolesRows

system.perspective.print("updateUserRoleAssets msg rcvd with %s"%payload)	

	updaterId = self.view.custom.security.userId
	userId = self.view.params.values.userId
	roleId = self.view.custom.roles.selectedData[0].roleId
	selectedAssets = payload['selection']
	assetIds = [asset['value']['assetId'] for asset in selectedAssets]
	userRoles = system.kanoa.security.getUserAssetRoles({'userId': userId, 'roleId': roleId})
	currentAssetIds = [record['assetId'] for record in userRoles]
	deleteAssets = [assetId for assetId in currentAssetIds if assetId not in assetIds]
	for assetId in deleteAssets:
		system.kanoa.security.deleteUserAssetRole({'userId': userId, 'roleId': roleId, 'assetId': assetId}, updaterId)
	
	insertAssets = [assetId for assetId in assetIds if assetId not in currentAssetIds]
	for assetId in insertAssets: system.kanoa.security.addUserAssetRole({'userId': userId, 'roleId': roleId, 'assetId': assetId}, updaterId)
	self.view.refreshBinding('custom.roles.data')
	system.perspective.sendMessage('updateUsers', {})
	return
